name: Titanium.UI.iOS.TransitionAnimation
summary:
A transition animation when opening or closing windows in a
[Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow](api:Titanium.UI.NavigationWindow) or [Titanium.UI.Tab](api:Titanium.UI.Tab).

Use this proxy with the Window's
[transitionAnimation](api:Titanium.UI.Window#transitionAnimation) property.

examples.title: Simple Example

properties.name: duration
properties.summary: Length of the transition in milliseconds.

properties.name: transitionFrom
properties.summary: Animation to hide the current window.

properties.name: transitionTo
properties.summary: Animation to show the new window.
